page.overview:
Who is Jackson P. Sayer?

Reverend Jackson P. Sayer is a character in .

Reverend Jackson P. Sayer was a man who was searching for some unknown evil for thirty years. He also seemed to be an alcoholic, which may have contributed to his state of mind. He saw Samuel Loomis on the road needing a ride to Haddonfield. On the way towards Haddonfield, he asked Loomis if he, too, was hunting evil. Sayer told Loomis that he could not kill evil like a man.
